name: draft-to-living-cell
title: From Draft to Living Cell
lead: A biological model can be specified as an inert, typed interface contract and only then compiled — one conforming mechanism installed per contract, interface preservation machine-checked — so mechanisms of any grain become swappable behind a boundary that provably does not move, and division becomes a first-class rewrite. The sharpest proof is one metabolism interface run three ways (coarse, saturating kinetics, and REAL COBRApy flux-balance), with a non-conforming impostor rejected at compile time.

at_a_glance.role: THE THESIS — one metabolism interface (Fig 6) run three ways: a coarse lumped yield, a saturating kinetic, and REAL COBRApy flux-balance, behind ports that never move. The headline control: a non-conforming impostor handler is rejected at compile time with a CompileError naming the missing ports.

Division as a FIRST-CLASS structural rewrite — the cell's own replicated DNA crosses a threshold and one cell node genuinely becomes two, conserving mass (the parent is partitioned, not duplicated). No wall clock.

The contract and its coupling — a cell specified as its typed exchange ports (Fig 4), then closed into a sense/act loop over a real diffusing spatial field (Fig 5); sensing and acting are one coupling.

From molecules to the nested cell — an F1Fo ATP-synthase molecular mechanism at the deepest grain feeding a gene-expression cascade across a six-level nested place graph; the deepest test of structural interface preservation.

The payoff — the thesis at whole-cell scale: one assembled cell (built by hand in the figures' style, not compiled), three swappable Fig 6 metabolisms, three distinct life histories — each grows, divides once (mass-conserved), and dies on a scripted thermal shock.

Appendix — every figure compiles and runs (11 figure drafts, 12 executable composites). Fig 9 self-organization and Fig 10-2/10-3 development/evolution are folded in here and deliberately deflated: they compile and run, but the selection is an ODE and the "new port" a config flag flip.

how_to_read:
Read the studies in thesis-first order. Start with one-interface-three-mechanisms — the
whole argument in one figure: one metabolism interface run three ways (coarse lumped yield, saturating
kinetics, and REAL COBRApy flux-balance), with a non-conforming impostor rejected at compile time. Then
divide (division as a first-class structural rewrite — the cell's own DNA crosses a threshold and one
cell node becomes two, conserving mass). Then typed-interface (the contract and its coupling — a cell
as its typed ports, closed into a sense/act loop over a real diffusing field). Then the-nested-cell (the
molecular grain — an ATP-synthase mechanism feeding a cascade across a six-level nested place graph, the
deepest test of structural interface preservation). Then the-living-atlas (the payoff — the same Fig 6
mechanism-swap carried up to a whole assembled cell: three metabolisms, three life histories, each
growing, dividing once, and dying). Finally the gallery appendix (every figure compiles and runs).

In each study, look at two things side by side: the DRAFT render (the loom figure — the structural
interface, no dynamics) and the EXECUTABLE dynamics (the same interface, now running). The investigation's
genuine control is the compiler's IMPOSTOR-REJECTION in one-interface-three-mechanisms: a handler that
breaks the port contract is refused at compile time with a CompileError naming the missing ports — that
is the interface being enforced, not merely described. (The per-study `draft-is-inert` checks are only
sanity checks of the framework's definition — a draft has an empty update by construction — not
scientific counterfactuals; where a real ablation would strengthen a claim, that is noted in the study.)

Short on time? Read one-interface-three-mechanisms (the thesis and its impostor control), divide (a
genuine structural rewrite), and the-living-atlas (the mechanism-swap at whole-cell scale). Throughout,
hold the compiler's law 2: did the mechanism change while the STRUCTURAL interface — port names, types,
wiring — stayed the same?

glossary.definition: The set of typed, unit-bearing variables through which a cellular description couples to its environment (fluxes, forces, currents, heat, plus growth, shape, objective, viability).
An interface with a STRUCTURAL contract but no dynamics — typed ports + wiring + intent, an inert (empty) update; it builds and renders but does nothing if run.
An executable Process that implements a draft's interface with real dynamics; the compiler installs one per draft.

STRUCTURAL conformance — a handler conforms to a signature when it supplies every interface port with a compatible type and wiring; the compiler refuses to install a non-conforming handler. It checks port names, types, and wiring — NOT units, dimensions, invariants, or runtime behavior.
Compilation changes a figure's internal mechanism but leaves its external interface — port names and wired store paths — identical.
Realizing one interface at a different level of description (a lumped process vs. a resolved network) without changing the interface — Fig 6.
A composition whose processes collectively produce and sustain the very organization that enables them — Fig 9's mutual closure of metabolism, containment, and replication.
The region of state space within which a cellular description stays valid; crossing them (e.g. a thermal shock) breaks the interface and forces a shift to a molecular description.
A discrete change to the place graph itself — division, engulfment, bursting — that adds or removes nodes at runtime (Fig 10; Fig 3c).
The nesting of stores in the state tree; the bigraph structure that represents compartments and containment.

biological_story:
A cell is two things at once. From the outside it is a bounded, goal-directed agent
that exchanges matter, energy, and information with its environment across a small set
of interface variables, and stays alive only while those variables sit inside its
viability bounds. From the inside it is a dense web of coupled molecular processes that
build and maintain the very interface the outside view depends on. Neither view is
complete alone, and the interesting biology lives in how they are connected — which is
exactly what a compositional model must make explicit.

This atlas walks that two-sided view as an arc, and at every step the same discipline
applies: first draw the *interface* (the ports through which a process couples to the
rest of the cell), commit to no mechanism yet, and only then install one. We begin at
the cellular interface itself (Fig 4) — chemical, mechanical, electrical, and thermal
exchange ports plus higher-level cellular variables like growth rate, shape, objective,
and viability. We make it operational by closing the loop with the environment (Fig 5):
the cell senses environmental fields and acts back on them, so sensing and acting become
two sides of one coupling. When regulation fails, the cellular description stops being
valid and the right level of description drops to molecules (Fig 6–7) — the disintegration
pattern, and its inverse, coarse-graining a molecular network back into a cell-level
exchange process. We then ask how a maintained interface arises in the first place: from
molecular mechanisms composing into nested, self-producing organization (Fig 8–9) — the
closure of metabolism, containment, and replication that Maturana and Varela called
autopoiesis. Finally, that organization is rewritten across time: a cell divides, cells
build a biofilm, and lineages evolve new interface capabilities (Fig 10).

The move this investigation adds is to make each step *run*. A draft process is an
interface with a STRUCTURAL contract — port names, types, and wiring — and no mechanism;
compiling it installs a conforming mechanism (the compiler checks that the handler supplies
every port with a compatible type, and preserves the ports and their wiring exactly) while
giving the figure real dynamics. Because the interface is what is held fixed, the same
figure can be run under different mechanisms — Fig 6's metabolism as a lumped yield, a
saturating kinetic law, or a genuine COBRApy flux-balance optimization — and a reader can
watch the mechanism change underneath a boundary that does not. That mechanism-swap is the
thesis, and it is carried up to a whole cell: an assembled whole cell — built BY HAND in
the figures' style, not emitted by the compiler from the drafts — runs the same Fig 6
swap, and coarse, kinetic, and real-FBA metabolism give three distinct life histories
behind one interface. In each, the cell takes up nutrients and grows, divides once its
biomass crosses a threshold (division conserves mass — the mother is halved, not doubled),
and — when a SCRIPTED thermal shock pushes its temperature outside the viable band (a
hard-coded 37 → 50 °C at t=12) — loses viability, stops maintaining its boundary, and
disintegrates into molecular debris. A cell that lives and dies, with the mechanism of its
life swappable behind a fixed boundary.
question:
How far can a cell be built compositionally — assembled from typed interfaces,
each specified as a *draft* before any mechanism is chosen, then compiled into
something that actually runs — and does that composition hold together into a
whole cell that lives and dies?
hypothesis:
Every recurring composition pattern in the cellular-interface paper can be
authored as an inert draft (typed, unit-bearing ports + a structural contract, with
no dynamics) and then *compiled* — by installing one conforming mechanism per
draft — into an executable that preserves the paper's interface exactly and
produces genuine dynamics. The same signature admits many mechanisms; the figures
compose; and the composition sustains a whole cell across growth, division, and
disintegration.

executive.what_is_this:
This investigation turns *A meta-modeler's guide to the cellular interface* into an executable test of compositional modeling. Each figure of the paper is written twice. First as a draft: a typed, unit-bearing biological interface — a STRUCTURAL contract of port names, types, and wiring, with no committed mechanism. It says what a process couples to, not how. Then it is compiled, which installs one or more conforming mechanisms — mechanistic, rule-based, data-driven, or otherwise — behind the identical ports, so the running simulation preserves the declared interface exactly. The compiler's conformance check is STRUCTURAL: it verifies that a handler supplies every port with a compatible type and wiring, and refuses one that does not. It does not check units, dimensions, invariants, or runtime behavior.

The point is not to assemble a single monolithic cell model. It is to test whether a biological model can remain open-ended as its mechanisms change, its assumptions fail, and its level of description shifts. Interfaces provide the places where models can be connected, isolated, replaced, or expanded; graph rewrites allow the composition itself to change through events such as growth, division, and disintegration.

The investigation therefore follows the paper's central claim: composition is not the final architecture of a model, but an ongoing way of building one. Across the studies below, we ask whether the same biological specification can support alternative mechanisms, whether those mechanisms can be composed without losing their interface semantics, and whether the resulting system can reorganize as the biology demands. The endpoint is a composed whole cell that grows, divides, loses viability, and changes its own level of description — demonstrating the full arc from interface specification to living, changing simulation.
executive.verdict:
The reading holds, and it runs. The thesis is sharpest in one figure: ONE metabolism interface
(Fig 6, nutrients ⇒ biomass) carries THREE genuinely different mechanisms — a coarse lumped yield, a
saturating Michaelis–Menten kinetic, and REAL COBRApy flux-balance analysis over e_coli_core — behind
ports that never move (law 4). The single most persuasive artifact is a negative one: a non-conforming
impostor handler that renames/retypes/drops those ports is REJECTED by the compiler at compile time
with a CompileError that names the missing ports. That is structural interface preservation (law 2)
made mechanical. The machinery is not cherry-picked: the paper's Figs 4–10 render as 11 figure drafts;
10 compile to executables (Fig 4a, the interaction-modalities vocabulary, is illustrative and draft-only
by design), and because Fig 6's one interface carries three mechanisms there are 12 executable
composites in all — every one runs to completion. Figure 10 makes division a FIRST-CLASS structural
rewrite: the cell's own replicated DNA crosses a threshold and one cell node genuinely becomes two,
conserving mass (the parent is partitioned, not duplicated). Finally the thesis lifts to the whole
cell: an assembled whole cell (built by hand in the figures' style, not compiled from the drafts) runs
the SAME Fig 6 mechanism-swap — coarse / kinetic / FBA give three distinct life histories (peak biomass
5.78 / 6.43 / 6.05, dividing at t≈3.0 / 2.1 / 2.7) — each cell growing, dividing once (mass-conserved),
and dying when a SCRIPTED thermal shock (37 → 50 °C hard-coded at t=12) collapses viability to 0.018
and disintegration turns biomass to debris.

scientific_argument.main_claim:
A cell can be assembled compositionally from typed interfaces, each specifiable as
a draft (an interface with no committed mechanism) and then compiled — by installing
a conforming mechanism — into a running model whose *external interface is preserved
unchanged*. This is the paper's central claim (mechanism can be refined or replaced
behind a stable interface) made mechanical, as a compiler whose laws enforce it.
evidence_for: Fig 4 — the cellular interface is a set of typed, unit-bearing ports (chemical mol·s⁻¹, mechanical N, electrical A, thermal W, growth hr⁻¹, viability); a draft declares them, a handler makes a bounded goal-directed cell out of them.
Fig 5 — cell–environment coupling closes as a sense/act loop over a shared field store; the executable diffuses a real spatial (map[float]) chemical field.

Fig 6 (THE THESIS) — one metabolism interface (nutrients ⇒ biomass, energy, entropy, secretions) is realized by a coarse process, a saturating-kinetic process, OR real COBRApy FBA — three mechanisms, one interface (handler independence, law 4). The headline control is a non-conforming impostor handler, REJECTED at compile time with a CompileError naming the missing ports (structural interface preservation, law 2).

Fig 8 — molecular composition is a six-level-deep nested place graph (ECM → membrane → cytoplasm → nucleus → chromosome …) with a coupled gene-expression cascade wired to its leaves; the interface survives the deepest nesting (law 2).

Fig 9 — a toy autocatalytic loop of metabolism, containment, and replication compiles and runs at coarse, self-organized, and molecular grains; it illustrates the closure PATTERN but is a stand-in, not a demonstration of autopoiesis (folded into the gallery, deflated).

Fig 10 — division is a FIRST-CLASS structural rewrite. The cell's own replicated DNA crosses a threshold (dna 1 → 3.06, threshold 2.0) and one cell node genuinely becomes two, conserving mass (the parent is partitioned to daughters, not duplicated). Fig 10-2 development and Fig 10-3 evolution also compile and run, but are deflated to the gallery — their selection is an ODE and their new port a config flag flip.

The whole cell (mechanism-swap at scale) — an assembled whole cell (built by hand in the figures' style, NOT compiled from the drafts) runs the Fig 6 mechanism-swap. Coarse, kinetic, and real-FBA metabolism behind one interface give three distinct life histories (peak biomass 5.78 / 6.43 / 6.05). Each grows, divides once (mass-conserved), and dies on a scripted thermal shock (37 → 50 °C at t=12) that collapses viability to 0.018 — law 4 carried from a single figure up to a composed cell.
evidence_against: The figures are toy-real, not calibrated — handlers use plausible constants, not fitted ones, so the dynamics demonstrate the *pattern* (ultrasensitivity, closure, division, disintegration) rather than a quantitatively validated cell.
Fig 4a (interaction modalities) is illustrative — a vocabulary of ports, not a mechanism — and remains draft-only by design.
caveats: Two layers, read deliberately: the DRAFT composites are inert (ports + contract, no dynamics) and are rendered in loom; the EXECUTABLE composites run and are shown as dynamics figures. A study's draft render and its executable dynamics are the same interface at two stages, not two different models.

The compiler is the binding stage only — it installs a conforming mechanism per draft; it does not fit parameters or invent mechanisms. Conformance is STRUCTURAL (port names, types, wiring), not behavioral — it does not check units, dimensions, invariants, or runtime behavior.

The capstone whole cell (the-living-atlas) is ASSEMBLED BY HAND in the figures' style, NOT emitted by the compiler from the figure drafts. Its death is a SCRIPTED thermal shock (hard-coded t=12), not an emergent failure; its division conserves mass (the mother is halved, not doubled).

studies.name: one-interface-three-mechanisms
studies.title: One Interface, Three Mechanisms
studies.question: Can a single metabolism interface — the ports nutrients ⇒ {biomass, energy, entropy, secretions} of Fig 6 — be realized by three genuinely different mechanisms (a lumped-yield process, a saturating-kinetic process, and a real flux-balance optimization via COBRApy) while every other part of the composite, and the interface itself, stays byte-for-byte the same?

findings.statement: The linear coarse-grain handler drives the shared interface to biomass 4.0. Confirmed: coarse → biomass 4.0 (energy 2.4, entropy 0.8, secretions 1.6).
The Michaelis–Menten handler reaches a DISTINCT endpoint on the identical interface — same ports, different mechanism, different trajectory (law 4). Confirmed: kinetic → biomass 2.667.
The real COBRApy FBA handler reaches its own distinct endpoint AND shows overflow metabolism: surplus carbon leaves as acetate on the secretions port. Confirmed: biomass 6.29, secretions 30.4.

The interface is a real STRUCTURAL contract, not a convention: an impostor handler that breaks the port names/types is rejected at compile time (law 2). Confirmed: NonConformingMetabolism raises a CompileError naming the missing biomass/energy/entropy/secretions ports — the study's headline control.

evidence.observed: compiler rejects impostor (CompileError names missing biomass/energy/entropy/secretions)

studies.claim: One metabolic interface can be realized by many mechanisms — a lumped yield, saturating kinetics, or a real flux-balance solver — each producing its own distinct dynamics, without changing what the interface exposes.

biological_validation.basis: Three conforming handlers each drive the shared nutrients ⇒ biomass interface to a DISTINCT endpoint (coarse 4.0, kinetic 2.667, FBA 6.29); the FBA handler additionally shows acetate overflow (secretions 30.4). The impostor handler that breaks the interface is rejected at compile time (law 2).

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Swapping lumped-yield, saturating-kinetic, and real-COBRApy handlers behind one fixed interface yields three distinct trajectories — making handler independence (law 4) concrete and measurable — while an impostor that breaks the contract is caught by the compiler.

derived.insight: The linear coarse-grain handler drives the shared interface to biomass 4.0. Confirmed: coarse → biomass 4.0 (energy 2.4, entropy 0.8, secretions 1.6).

studies.name: divide
studies.title: Divide
studies.question: Is cell division in Fig 10 a genuine structural rewrite of the place graph — a single cell node actually becoming two daughter nodes at runtime, fired by the cell's own replicated DNA crossing a threshold — rather than a pre-declared post-structure that is merely animated on a wall clock?

findings.statement: Replicated DNA crossing a threshold fires a division event — no wall clock. Confirmed: parent dna 1 → 3.06 crosses dna_threshold 2.0, the rewrite fires once, cell_count 1 → 2.

evidence.observed: parent dna 1 → 3.06 crosses threshold 2.0; cell_count 1 → 2 (one division)

findings.statement: The division spawns two structurally-new daughter nodes and CONSERVES MASS. Confirmed: each daughter inherits dna 0 → 2.75 and biomass 0 → 0.5 while the parent biomass falls to 0 (the parent is halved, not doubled).

evidence.observed: each daughter dna 0 → 2.75, biomass 0 → 0.5; parent biomass → 0 (mass conserved)

findings.statement: Sanity check on the framework's definition: the inert draft, with no mechanism, has an empty update and stays at seed. Confirmed: inert draft cell_count stays 1 (it fails the division threshold by design — the definition of a draft, not a scientific control).

evidence.observed: inert draft stays at cell_count 1 (empty update by construction)

studies.claim: Division is a change to the composition itself, triggered by the cell's own replicated DNA crossing a threshold: one cell becomes two through a graph rewrite that creates new nodes at runtime and conserves mass (the parent is halved, not doubled) — not a pre-drawn pair on a timer.

biological_validation.basis: Division-fires and daughters-spawn both pass — the DNA threshold is crossed, the rewrite fires once, and mass is conserved across the partition; the inert draft stays at cell_count 1, so division is a real runtime rewrite.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Watching one cell node be replaced by two structurally-new daughters — fired by the cell's own DNA crossing a threshold, with mass conserved — makes division-as-graph-rewrite concrete rather than animated on a clock.

derived.insight: Replicated DNA crossing a threshold fires a division event — no wall clock. Confirmed: parent dna 1 → 3.06 crosses dna_threshold 2.0, the rewrite fires once, cell_count 1 → 2.

studies.name: typed-interface
studies.title: The Contract and Its Coupling
studies.question: Can the cellular boundary be specified as nothing but a set of typed, unit-bearing exchange ports (Fig 4) with no committed mechanism, compiled — by installing one conforming handler — into a running, bounded, goal-directed cell whose interface is exactly the one declared; and does that same interface become a genuine sense/act LOOP (Fig 5) when the environment is a real diffusing spatial field the cell reads and acts back on?

findings.statement: Installing one conforming handler grows the cell through its interface. Confirmed: shape 1.0 → 4.2.
The cell takes up chemical across its interface (net negative flux). Confirmed: chemical flux 0.0 → -0.8.
The cell makes progress toward its declared objective as growth proceeds. Confirmed: objective 0.0 → 1.6.
The same interface becomes a coupling: the cell senses the field at its location and draws it down by taking up matter. Confirmed: uptake flux 0.0 → 0.34, bolus cell 1.0 → 0.2.
The cell acts back mechanically on its environment — sensing and acting are one coupling. Confirmed: traction 0.0 → 0.41.
The cell drives a mechanical field in the shared environment store. Confirmed: mechanical field 0.0 → 0.94.

studies.claim: A cell can be specified at one level by its typed interface — exchange variables such as chemical flux, force, current, heat, growth, shape, objective, and viability — without committing to a mechanism; and that same interface is a genuine coupling in which sensing and acting are one relationship over a shared field store, not two subsystems.

biological_validation.basis: The interface tests (shape, chemical, objective) and the coupling tests (uptake, traction, mechanical field) all pass on measured readouts; the inert-draft sanity check stays at its 1.0 shape seed, isolating the installed handler as the cause.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Compiling the inert Fig 4 interface into a running cell, then closing it into a Fig 5 sense/act loop over a real diffusing field, makes structural interface-preservation and the "one coupling, not two" claim directly observable in one study.

derived.insight: Installing one conforming handler grows the cell through its interface. Confirmed: shape 1.0 → 4.2.

studies.name: the-nested-cell
studies.title: From Molecules to the Nested Cell
studies.question: How do molecules compose into a cell? At the deepest grain a single molecular machine — F1Fo ATP synthase (Fig 7) — is compiled from its draft and run as a PMF-driven rotary catalyst that synthesizes ATP on its chemical output port. That mechanism sits at the bottom of the Fig 8 nested cell — a deeply nested place graph (membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, chromosome, chromatin, nucleosome) with a gene-expression cascade wired to its deepest leaves. Does compilation preserve every interface, from the lone molecular mechanism up through six levels of nesting?

findings.statement: At the deepest grain, the F1Fo ATP synthase mechanism — compiled from the Fig 7 draft and run through the engine — synthesizes ATP on its chemical output port, feeding the cell above it. Confirmed: chemical_out (ATP synthesized) 0→100 via PMF-driven rotary catalysis.
Metabolism feeds the cascade, each observable rising from zero to its own level. Confirmed: nutrients→2.4, metabolites→1.5, energy→0.84.
The transcription–translation cascade produces a small mRNA and protein pool. Confirmed: mRNA→0.18, protein→0.008.

Sanity check on the framework's definition: the inert draft, with no mechanism, has an empty update and stays at seed. Confirmed: draft produces no motion on the declared ports (the definition of a draft, not a scientific control). The real evidence is that the compiled mechanisms drive the ports with the interface structurally preserved to the deepest leaf (ribosomal complex ≈0.50).

evidence.observed: inert draft stays at seed (empty update by construction)

studies.claim: A molecular mechanism (F1Fo ATP synthase) sits at the deepest grain and feeds a gene-expression cascade nested across six place-graph levels; each interface is preserved, from the lone molecular machine up to the deepest leaf of the nesting.

biological_validation.basis: The molecular mechanism synthesizes ATP (chemical_out 0→100), the metabolite and mRNA cascades populate, and the inert draft stays at seed — isolating the compiled mechanisms as the cause.

regression_compatibility.basis: All figure composites build and every executable runs to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: Placing a molecular machine (ATP synthase) at the base of a central-dogma cascade wired through a six-level place graph makes deep interface-preservation observable from the molecular grain to the leaf.

derived.insight: At the deepest grain, the F1Fo ATP synthase mechanism — compiled from the Fig 7 draft and run through the engine — synthesizes ATP on its chemical output port, feeding the cell above it. Confirmed: chemical_out (ATP synthesized) 0→100 via PMF-driven rotary catalysis.

studies.name: the-living-atlas
studies.title: The Living Atlas
studies.question: The thesis of the investigation — one typed interface, many mechanisms — is proven at the level of a single figure (Fig 6). Does it also hold at the level of a WHOLE CELL? This capstone assembles a composed whole cell in the figures' style — cell–environment uptake, a viability-gated Fig 6 metabolism, a viability monitor, and the division and disintegration rewrites, wired through shared cell and environment stores — and then SWAPS the Fig 6 metabolism behind identical ports (coarse, saturating kinetic, or real COBRApy FBA). Same cell, three mechanisms: does each produce its own life history while the interface never moves, and does each cell still grow, divide (mass-conserved), and die?

findings.statement: The thesis holds at the whole-cell level: with the COARSE Fig 6 metabolism installed behind the unchanged interface, the assembled cell grows to its own peak and divides at its own time. Confirmed: peak biomass 5.78, divides at t≈3.0.

Swapping in the SATURATING-KINETIC metabolism behind the identical ports gives a DISTINCT life history — mechanism-swap (law 4) at the whole-cell level. Confirmed: peak biomass 6.43, divides earlier at t≈2.1.

evidence.observed: kinetic — peak biomass 6.43, divides t≈2.1 (distinct from coarse)

findings.statement: Swapping in the REAL COBRApy FBA metabolism behind the identical ports gives a third distinct life history. Confirmed: peak biomass 6.05, divides at t≈2.7.

evidence.observed: fba (real COBRApy) — peak biomass 6.05, divides t≈2.7

findings.statement: The composed cell DIVIDES ONCE and division CONSERVES MASS. Confirmed: the rewrite fires once, cell_count 1 → 2, the mother's biomass partitioned (mother halved, not doubled).

The composed cell DIES on a SCRIPTED shock. Confirmed: the ThermalEnvironment process drives temperature 37 → 50 °C at a hard-coded t=12, the viability monitor collapses viability 1.0 → 0.018, metabolism gates off, and disintegration converts biomass to molecular debris (≈5.5–6.1).

evidence.observed: viability 1.0 → 0.018 after a scripted shock (temperature 37 → 50 at t=12); debris ≈5.5–6.1

studies.claim: The investigation's thesis holds at the whole-cell level: behind ONE unchanged metabolism interface, the Fig 6 mechanism is swappable (coarse / saturating-kinetic / real COBRApy FBA) and the SAME assembled cell lives three distinct life histories — peak biomass 5.78 / 6.43 / 6.05, dividing at t≈3.0 / 2.1 / 2.7. In every case the cell grows, divides once (cell_count 1 → 2, mass-conserved — the mother is halved), and dies when a scripted thermal shock (37 → 50 °C at t=12) collapses viability to 0.018 and disintegration converts biomass to debris. The cell is assembled by hand in the figures' style, not compiled from the figure drafts.

biological_validation.basis: Behind one unchanged metabolism interface, the three Fig 6 mechanisms give three distinct whole-cell life histories (peak biomass 5.78 / 6.43 / 6.05, dividing at t≈3.0 / 2.1 / 2.7); in every case the cell grows, divides once (cell_count 1 → 2, mass-conserved), and dies when a scripted thermal shock (37 → 50 °C at t=12) collapses viability to 0.018 and disintegration turns biomass to debris — mechanism-swap (law 4) demonstrated at the whole-cell level.

regression_compatibility.basis: The assembled whole-cell composite runs 20 steps to completion under all three metabolism selections (coarse/kinetic/fba) via scripts/run_wholecell.py.

explanatory_gain.basis: Swapping coarse, saturating-kinetic, and real-COBRApy metabolisms behind one whole-cell interface — and watching the same cell live three distinct life histories while the interface never moves — carries the investigation's thesis from a single figure up to a composed cell.

derived.insight: The thesis holds at the whole-cell level: with the COARSE Fig 6 metabolism installed behind the unchanged interface, the assembled cell grows to its own peak and divides at its own time. Confirmed: peak biomass 5.78, divides at t≈3.0.

studies.name: gallery
studies.title: Gallery — Every Figure Compiles and Runs
studies.question: Does every one of the paper's figures compile from its draft to an executable that runs to completion? This appendix is a COVERAGE result, not a scientific claim about any single figure: it shows the draft→executable machinery works uniformly across all of the paper's figures — including the ones not promoted to their own study (Fig 9 self-organization/coarse-graining, and the Fig 10-2/10-3 development and evolution rewrites).

findings.statement: Coverage: every figure of the paper compiles to a running executable. Confirmed: 12/12 executable composites run to completion; fig07's ATP synthase charging chemical_out 0 → 100 is a representative witness. (This is a machinery-coverage result, not a scientific claim about any single figure — Fig 9's closure is a toy autocatalytic loop, and Fig 10-2/10-3's development and evolution are an ODE and a config flag flip.)

evidence.observed: 12/12 executables run to completion; fig07 chemical_out 0 → 100

studies.claim: Every figure of the paper compiles and runs: 11 figure drafts (Figs 4–10 rendered as composites), 10 compiling to executables (Fig 4a is illustrative, draft-only by design), and 12 executable composites in all (Fig 6's one interface carries three mechanisms) — every one runs to completion. This is a coverage/appendix result about the machinery, not a scientific claim about any individual figure.

biological_validation.basis: Coverage only — every figure draft compiles to an executable that runs. No biological claim is made about any individual figure in this appendix.

regression_compatibility.basis: All 12 fig*-executable composites build and run to completion (scripts/build_executables.py + scripts/measure_all.py, 2026-08-16).

explanatory_gain.basis: A single appendix that shows the draft→executable machinery runs uniformly across all of the paper's figures backs the focused studies without over-claiming the figures folded in here.

derived.insight: Coverage: every figure of the paper compiles to a running executable. Confirmed: 12/12 executable composites run to completion; fig07's ATP synthase charging chemical_out 0 → 100 is a representative witness. (This is a machinery-coverage result, not a scientific claim about any single figure — Fig 9's closure is a toy autocatalytic loop, and Fig 10-2/10-3's development and evolution are an ODE and a config flag flip.)
